dialogue.text: In Asia, war breaks out on the Korean Peninsula, as forces from the Communist North
dialogue.zh: 在亞洲，朝鮮半島爆發戰爭，共產主義北方勢力
dialogue.ja: アジアで、朝鮮半島に戦争が勃発し、共産主義の北朝鮮軍が
dialogue.local: In Asia, war breaks out on the Korean Peninsula, as forces from the Communist North
dialogue.en: In Asia, war breaks out on the Korean Peninsula, as forces from the Communist North

dialogue.text: invade the non-Communist South, United States soon joins the fighting on the side of South
dialogue.zh: 入侵非共產主義的南方，美國很快加入南方一方的戰鬥，
dialogue.ja: 非共産主義の南を侵攻し、アメリカ合衆国はすぐに南側の戦いに参加します。
dialogue.local: invade the non-Communist South, United States soon joins the fighting on the side of South
dialogue.en: invade the non-Communist South, United States soon joins the fighting on the side of South

dialogue.text: Korea, President Harry Truman.
dialogue.zh: 韓國，總統哈利·杜魯門。
dialogue.ja: 韓国、ハリー・トルーマン大統領。
dialogue.local: Korea, President Harry Truman.
dialogue.en: Korea, President Harry Truman.

dialogue.text: Korea is a small country, thousands of miles away, but if what is happening here is
dialogue.zh: 韓國是一個小國，距離數千英里，但如果這裡發生的事情是
dialogue.ja: 韓国は小さな国で、何千マイルも離れていますが、ここで起きていることが
dialogue.local: Korea is a small country, thousands of miles away, but if what is happening here is
dialogue.en: Korea is a small country, thousands of miles away, but if what is happening here is

dialogue.text: in part into every American.
dialogue.zh: 部分影響到每一位美國人。
dialogue.ja: ある意味で全てのアメリカ人に関係しているのです。
dialogue.local: in part into every American.
dialogue.en: in part into every American.

dialogue.text: In Montana, the Battle of Little Big Horn, that's where Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong
dialogue.zh: 在蒙大拿州，小大角戰役，這裡是喬治·阿姆斯特朗中校
dialogue.ja: モンタナ州で、小ビッグホーンの戦いがあり、そこではジョージ・アームストロング中佐が
dialogue.local: In Montana, the Battle of Little Big Horn, that's where Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong
dialogue.en: In Montana, the Battle of Little Big Horn, that's where Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong

dialogue.text: Custer and his seventh cavalry are wiped out by Sue and Cheyenne Indians.
dialogue.zh: 卡斯特和他的第七騎兵被蘇族和夏安族印第安人消滅。
dialogue.ja: カスター中佐と彼の第7騎兵隊がスー族とシャイアン族のインディアンに壊滅させられました。
dialogue.local: Custer and his seventh cavalry are wiped out by Sue and Cheyenne Indians.
dialogue.en: Custer and his seventh cavalry are wiped out by Sue and Cheyenne Indians.

dialogue.text: On Capitol Hill, former White House Council John Dean begins testifying before the Senate
dialogue.zh: 在國會山，前白宮法律顧問約翰·迪恩開始在參議院作證，
dialogue.ja: キャピトルヒルで、元ホワイトハウス顧問のジョン・ディーンが上院の前で証言を始めます。
dialogue.local: On Capitol Hill, former White House Council John Dean begins testifying before the Senate
dialogue.en: On Capitol Hill, former White House Council John Dean begins testifying before the Senate

dialogue.text: panel investigating the Watergate scandal.
dialogue.zh: 調查水門事件的參議院小組。
dialogue.ja: ウォーターゲート事件を調査する上院の委員会の前で。
dialogue.local: panel investigating the Watergate scandal.
dialogue.en: panel investigating the Watergate scandal.

dialogue.text: I began by telling the President that there was a cancer growing on the presidency, and
dialogue.zh: 我開始告訴總統，總統職位上有一個癌症正在蔓延，
dialogue.ja: 私は大統領に、大統領職に癌が広がっていると話し始めました。
dialogue.local: I began by telling the President that there was a cancer growing on the presidency, and
dialogue.en: I began by telling the President that there was a cancer growing on the presidency, and

dialogue.text: if the cancer was not removed, the President himself would be killed by it.
dialogue.zh: 如果不移除這個癌症，總統本人將會被它摧毀。
dialogue.ja: もしその癌が取り除かれなければ、大統領自身がそれによって殺されるだろうと。
dialogue.local: if the cancer was not removed, the President himself would be killed by it.
dialogue.en: if the cancer was not removed, the President himself would be killed by it.

dialogue.text: The scandal forces Richard Nixon to become the first President to resign the following
dialogue.zh: 這場醜聞迫使理查德·尼克森成為第一位辭職的總統，
dialogue.ja: このスキャンダルにより、リチャード・ニクソンは初めて辞任した大統領となりました。
dialogue.local: The scandal forces Richard Nixon to become the first President to resign the following
dialogue.en: The scandal forces Richard Nixon to become the first President to resign the following

dialogue.text: year.
dialogue.zh: 次年。
dialogue.ja: 翌年です。
dialogue.local: year.
dialogue.en: year.

dialogue.text: George Orwell, the author whose novels include Animal Farm in 1984, is born Eric Blair
dialogue.zh: 喬治·奧威爾，著有《動物農場》和《1984》的作家，出生名為埃里克·布萊爾，
dialogue.ja: ジョージ・オーウェルは、『動物農場』や『1984年』の著者で、本名はエリック・ブレアとして生まれました。
dialogue.local: George Orwell, the author whose novels include Animal Farm in 1984, is born Eric Blair
dialogue.en: George Orwell, the author whose novels include Animal Farm in 1984, is born Eric Blair

dialogue.text: in Bengal, India.
dialogue.zh: 在印度孟加拉出生。
dialogue.ja: インドのベンガルで。
dialogue.local: in Bengal, India.
dialogue.en: in Bengal, India.

dialogue.ja: そして1997年。

dialogue.text: The reason why he loved the sea, I cannot explain.
dialogue.zh: 他為什麼熱愛大海，我無法解釋。
dialogue.ja: 彼がなぜ海を愛したのか、説明できません。
dialogue.local: The reason why he loved the sea, I cannot explain.
dialogue.en: The reason why he loved the sea, I cannot explain.

dialogue.text: That was the way it happened to me.
dialogue.zh: 這就是它發生在我身上的方式。
dialogue.ja: それが私に起こった方法でした。
dialogue.local: That was the way it happened to me.
dialogue.en: That was the way it happened to me.

dialogue.text: Jacques Cousteau, the underwater explorer and filmmaker dies in Paris at age 87.
dialogue.zh: 水下探險家和電影製作人雅克·庫斯托在巴黎去世，享年87歲。
dialogue.ja: 水中探検家で映画製作者のジャック・クストーがパリで87歳で亡くなりました。
dialogue.local: Jacques Cousteau, the underwater explorer and filmmaker dies in Paris at age 87.
dialogue.en: Jacques Cousteau, the underwater explorer and filmmaker dies in Paris at age 87.

dialogue.text: Today in history, June 25th, Tim McGuire, the Associated Press.
dialogue.zh: 歷史上的今天，6月25日，美聯社的蒂姆·麥圭爾報導。
dialogue.ja: 今日は歴史上の6月25日、AP通信のティム・マクガイアです。
dialogue.local: Today in history, June 25th, Tim McGuire, the Associated Press.
dialogue.en: Today in history, June 25th, Tim McGuire, the Associated Press.
